meta.title: Hazards now lists each place hazard with its level (Raised / Open)
meta.requirement: AC7 + AC2 — hazard levels: rain 12 mm → mudslide/flood Raised, road Open
precondition: Peak PLACE with hazards mudslide, flood, road; season open
Forecast: window day Sun rain 12 mm (≥10 → Caution, < 30), everything else MILD
steps: Cold-start, open the place, scroll to 'Hazards now' → check: `place.hazards-now` shown
expected: `place.hazard.mudslide` and `place.hazard.flood` exist and their `.level` reads 'Raised' — UI tree + screenshot
`place.hazard.road` exists and its `.level` reads 'Open' — UI tree
The three levels equal the API `GET /v1/places/{id}/condition` hazards (raised, raised, open) and no row for a hazard the place lacks (`place.hazard.heat`) — API + UI tree
